rules.title: Relocation Assistance and Tenant Protections for Demolition for New Construction under Resident Protections Ordinance
rules.requirement: A landlord terminating tenancy to demolish a Protected Unit for new construction must file a Declaration of Intent to Evict or Notice of Intent to Withdraw with LAHD, serve written notice to tenants, and pay relocation assistance per State or City law, whichever is higher, including enhanced amounts for lower income tenants under the Resident Protections Ordinance effective 2/11/2025.
rules.summary_plain: If your landlord wants to evict you to demolish your unit for new construction, they must notify the city, give you written notice, and pay you relocation assistance that is higher for lower income tenants.
rules.summary_plain_es: Si su arrendador quiere desalojarlo para demoler su unidad y construir algo nuevo, debe notificar a la ciudad, darle un aviso por escrito y pagarle asistencia para la reubicación, que es mayor para inquilinos de bajos ingresos.
rules.coverage_conditions_text: Applies to Protected Units that are residential dwelling units subject to rent or price control or rented by lower income households within the past five years, or withdrawn under Ellis Act within past 10 years.
rules.exemptions_text: Units that are not Protected Units or not occupied by lower income tenants follow regular RSO or JCO relocation rules.
rules.penalty: Financial penalties starting at $250,000 per displaced unit and withholding of LAHD permit clearances for failure to comply with RPO.
rules.citation: Los Angeles Municipal Code Sections 151.22-151.28, 165.03.I(1); Ordinances #188481 and #188482
rules.quoted_span: A landlord terminating a tenancy to demolish for new construction is required to pay relocation assistance and to file a Declaration of Intent to Evict or Notice of Intent to Withdraw Units From Rental Housing Use with the Los Angeles Housing Department (LAHD) prior to evicting tenants from units covered by the Rent Stabilization Ordinance (RSO) or the Just Cause Ordinance (JCO).

rules.title: Relocation Assistance Payment Requirements
rules.requirement: Landlords must pay relocation assistance to tenants within 15 days of serving a notice to terminate tenancy, with amounts set by RSO, JCO, or State Housing Crisis Act, whichever is higher, and enhanced for lower income tenants under the Resident Protections Ordinance.
rules.summary_plain: If your landlord evicts you for demolition, they must pay you relocation assistance within 15 days of notice, with higher amounts for lower income tenants.
rules.summary_plain_es: Si su arrendador lo desaloja por demolición, debe pagarle asistencia para la reubicación dentro de 15 días después del aviso, con montos mayores para inquilinos de bajos ingresos.
rules.coverage_conditions_text: Applies to tenants of units covered by RSO, JCO, or State Housing Crisis Act, especially lower income tenants under the Resident Protections Ordinance.
rules.exemptions_text: Not applicable to units that are not Protected Units or not occupied by lower income tenants, which follow regular RSO or JCO rules.
rules.citation: Los Angeles Municipal Code Sections 151.22-151.28; Ordinances #188481 and #188482; California Government Code Section 66300 et seq.
rules.quoted_span: City laws require all tenants be paid relocation assistance in the amounts required by the RSO or JCO within 15 days of serving a notice to terminate tenancy, which must be enhanced for lower income tenants if the project is subject to the Resident Protections Ordinance (RPO), effective 2/11/2025 under Ordinances # 188481 and #188482.
